Jason’s Deli Menu: Discover the Delicious Options for Every Taste

Jason’s Deli is known for offering a wide array of delicious, fresh menu items that cater to various preferences and dietary needs. Whether you’re dining in, placing an order online, or seeking food delivery, Jason’s Deli provides natural ingredients and wholesome meals that make it a go-to restaurant for many. In this article, we’ll dive into the Jason’s Deli menu, explore pricing, and help you discover the best deals and combinations they offer, from their famous specialty sandwiches to their nutritious salads and soups. With our comprehensive guide, you’ll have all the information you need to enjoy Jason’s Deli the way you like it.

Overview of Jason’s Deli

Jason’s Deli was founded with the vision of providing fresh, natural, and wholesome food using high-quality ingredients. They are known for their commitment to serving meals free of artificial trans fats, MSG, and high-fructose corn syrup. Jason’s Deli offers a diverse range of menu items that include specialty sandwiches, soups, salads, and much more.

Their offerings cover a wide variety of flavors, catering to those who love comfort food, health-conscious eaters, and anyone in between. With options to dine in, order online, or opt for food delivery, Jason’s Deli provides flexibility and convenience.

Jason’s Deli Menu Options

The Jason’s Deli menu has something for everyone. Let’s explore the different sections of their menu and the items they offer:

Specialty Sandwiches

Jason’s Deli specialty sandwiches are the heart of the menu, featuring flavorful ingredients and made-to-order perfection. Some of their most popular sandwiches include:

Sandwich Ingredients Price
Hot Pastrami Sandwich Hot pastrami, red onions, leafy lettuce, served with chips $8.99
Muffaletta Muffaletta bread, roasted turkey breast, pastrami, herbs, spices $6.99
Roast Beef Sandwich Roast beef, toasted multigrain wheat, aioli, red onions, toppings $9.49
Chicken Salad Croissant Antibiotic-free chicken breast, lettuce, honey mustard, toasted croissant $8.49

These sandwiches are often served with chips or baked chips, and can be customized to your liking.

💡 Recreate the Deli Experience at Home:

Inspired by the made-to-order perfection of Jason’s Deli? You can easily bring the deli experience to your kitchen.

  • Toasting sandwiches like the Hot Pastrami or the Roast Beef is key to maximum flavor. Try a Non-Stick Panini Press / Grill to get that perfectly toasted, professional finish on your creations.  

  • For those who want true deli-thin cuts of meat, a Commercial-Style Deli Slicer (Home Use) makes all the difference for your own roast beef, ham, or pastrami. 

  • Don’t forget the tools for perfection: A quality Serrated Sandwich Knife & Spatula Set is ideal for cleanly slicing through thick layers and spreading your favorite aioli or honey mustard. [Amazon Link: Sandwich Knife Set]

Soups

Jason’s Deli soups are a comforting and hearty option for those who love a warm bowl of goodness. Some top choices include:

Soup Description Price
Broccoli Cheese Soup Rich, creamy soup with fresh broccoli and cheddar cheese $4.99
Chicken Pot Pie Soup Classic chicken pot pie flavors in a hearty soup $5.49
Gumbo Southern dish with chicken, sausage, and rice in a flavorful broth $5.49
Tomato Basil Soup Refreshing, healthy tomato-based soup with a hint of basil $4.99

🥣 Essential Tools for Homemade Soup:

Making a large batch of Jason’s Deli-style soup is easy and cost-effective.

  • To get the creamy, restaurant-quality consistency for your Broccoli Cheese Soup or Tomato Basil Soup, an Immersion Hand Blender is a game-changer. No need to transfer hot liquids!  

  • A sturdy Large Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven is the perfect vessel for simmering rich broths like the Gumbo or large batches of any hearty soup. 

  • If you’re into meal prep, grab some Silicone Freezer Storage Trays (like Souper Cubes). They let you perfectly portion and freeze individual cups of your favorite soup for a quick, healthy meal anytime.

Salad Bar and Salad Options

Jason’s Deli prides itself on offering a salad bar with an extensive variety of fresh ingredients. You can create your salad with toppings like avocado, roasted corn and black beans, and romaine lettuce. Additionally, Jason’s Deli offers pre-made salads such as:

Salad Option Description Price
Chicken Caesar Salad Romaine lettuce, grilled antibiotic-free chicken breast, Caesar dressing $8.99
Garden Fresh Salad Organic field greens, leafy lettuce, roasted corn, hard-boiled egg, balsamic vinaigrette $7.99
Chicken Salad Roasted chicken breast, leafy greens, tomato, jalapeño ranch dressing $8.49
Build Your Own Salad Bar Choose from toppings like avocado, roasted corn, black beans, romaine lettuce $8.29

The salad bar allows for customization, and the menu features salads that cater to various dietary preferences, including vegetarian and low-calorie options.

🥗 Tools for a Professional Salad Bar at Home:

  • Ensure your lettuce for the Chicken Caesar Salad and Garden Fresh Salad is perfectly crisp (not soggy!) with a Large Capacity Salad Spinner. [Amazon Link: Salad Spinner]

  • Inspired by the deli’s high-quality dressings? Mix your own Balsamic Vinaigrette or ranch in a dedicated Salad Dressing Shaker & Mixer Bottle. [Amazon Link: Dressing Shaker]

  • For the busy professional, a Bento-Style Salad Container with Compartments is perfect for packing your custom-built salad, keeping your greens, toppings (like avocado), and dressing separate until lunch.

Nutrition Information and Natural Ingredients

Jason’s Deli is committed to serving healthy food, and many of their menu items feature natural ingredients. They use antibiotic-free chicken breast, nitrite-free smoked turkey breast, and serve multigrain wheat bread. Their salads and sandwiches offer a range of nutrient-rich toppings, including roasted corn, black beans, and avocado.

Each menu item comes with calorie information, allowing you to make informed choices about what you’re eating. For example:

Menu Item Calories (per serving) Notable Natural Ingredients
Garden Fresh Salad 150-160 cal Organic field greens, balsamic vinaigrette, roasted corn, hard-boiled egg
Chicken Salad Croissant 300-350 cal Antibiotic-free chicken breast, leafy lettuce, honey mustard
Broccoli Cheese Soup 200-250 cal Fresh broccoli, cheddar cheese
Chicken Caesar Salad 350-400 cal Romaine lettuce, grilled antibiotic-free chicken breast, Caesar dressing

For those watching their caloric intake, Jason’s Deli offers a variety of lower-calorie options, and their menu clearly lists nutritional information for every item.

🌱 Elevate Your Pantry with Quality Ingredients:

Since Jason’s Deli focuses on natural ingredients, upgrade your own pantry staples.

  • Swap out store-bought dressing for high-quality, flavorful condiments. A bottle of High-Quality Aged Balsamic Vinegar can elevate your vinaigrettes and act as a gourmet drizzle on sandwiches and vegetables. 

  • Look for a Small-Batch, Clean Label Gourmet Mustard or Aioli to use on your homemade specialty sandwiches, ensuring you avoid high-fructose corn syrup and artificial ingredients. 

  • Keep a supply of Organic, Low-Sodium Chicken or Vegetable Broth on hand for making your own wholesome, lower-sodium versions of their comforting soups. 

Order Jason’s Deli Online

Jason’s Deli makes it easy to enjoy their menu from the comfort of your home. You can order food online directly through their website or app. Food delivery services like DoorDash and UberEats also partner with Jason’s Deli for convenient, fast delivery with 0 delivery fee options in certain promotions.

How to Order

To place your order, simply visit the Jason’s Deli website or mobile app. Choose from the extensive menu, customize your meal, and select the food delivery option or pick-up. You can also order Jason’s Deli catering for events, with various options to suit your needs.

Catering with Jason’s Deli

Jason’s Deli offers catering services that are perfect for office lunches, parties, and events. Their catering menu includes:

Catering Option Description Price
Party Trays Filled with specialty sandwiches, croissants, baked chips Varies
Salad Platters Fresh salad bar ingredients with your choice of toppings Varies
Soup Bar Choose from popular options like broccoli cheese, chicken pot pie, or gumbo Varies
Baked Potatoes Large baked potatoes with toppings such as sour cream, cheese, and roasted corn Varies

🍽️ Host Your Own Deli-Style Event:

  • For events, a large, Reusable/Decorative Sectioned Party Platter will help you elegantly present your own specialty sandwich quarters and gourmet finger foods.

  • If you’re inspired to do more home cooking and meal prep like the deli, investing in Glass Meal Prep Containers (Airtight, 3-4 Compartments) is essential for storing daily lunches or catering leftovers safely. 

  • Want more recipes? Check out a popular Deli-Style Sandwich and Salad Copycat Recipe Book to expand your menu beyond the Jason’s Deli favorites. [Amazon Link: Recipe Book]

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I customize my sandwich?

Yes, you can customize any sandwich at Jason’s Deli, adding or removing ingredients as you wish.

Does Jason’s Deli offer vegan options?

Yes, Jason’s Deli offers several vegan-friendly menu items, including salads and certain soups. They also provide options to customize your meal to suit your dietary needs.

How much is the delivery fee for Jason’s Deli?

Jason’s Deli offers 0 delivery fee promotions through certain food delivery apps, and fees may vary depending on location.

Conclusion

Jason’s Deli is a beloved restaurant that offers a diverse menu full of natural ingredients and delicious meals. Whether you’re dining in, ordering online, or catering an event, Jason’s Deli provides something for everyone. From hearty specialty sandwiches to fresh salads and comforting soups, Jason’s Deli delivers flavor in every bite. With flexible pricing and convenient food delivery options, you can enjoy a delicious meal whenever and wherever you like.
